text:
morgan: quick sync — coordinated cutover in 20m. Targets: API=v3.3.0, runtime=kernel-qt2.3, console=6.4.0, router=header-proxy-v1. Plan: warmup 2% -> canary 10% -> PAUSE25 -> ramp 60% -> 100%. token rotation overlaps with window. Any red flags?

alex: +1. Add 5m observation after 60% to catch tail latency. Request manual approval at PAUSE25.

emily: console will flip asset flag at +9m and set CDN TTL=30s for 15m. Console rollback includes CDN purge (~4m). I'll own edge invalidation. Release notes patched.

sasha: security note — token rotation from identity team starts T+6m. We must ensure auth passthrough works across canary. If auth errors >0.3% in 90s, rollback router.

jay: observability: probes: /health, /v1/chat/ping, /v1/embeddings/ping. Thresholds: p95>160ms OR error_rate>0.7% sustained 90s -> auto rollback. I'll post stage metrics. T-5 smoke volunteer?

morgan: i'll need @jay to run smoke and @alex to approve PAUSE25. rollback order: runtime -> api -> router -> console. exception: if auth breaks, router first. rollback targets: kernel-qt2.2, api=3.2.x, router=revert-header-proxy, console=6.3.x.

deploy-bot: Deploy queued by morgan: "cutover-8219876543". Start in 20m. Pins applied: API=3.3.0, Runtime=kernel-qt2.3. PAUSE_AT_25 configured with manual gate. Rollback window: 45m. To cancel: `/deploy cancel cutover-8219876543`. Resume: `/deploy resume cutover-8219876543`. Auto-abort conditions attached.

jay: I'll run T-5 smoke: `curl -sS https://api.redwood.test/health | jq -r '.status'` and `curl -I https://api.redwood.test/health | grep X-Runtime-Kernel`. I'll also run token check: `curl -sS -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" https://api.redwood.test/user | jq .id`. Posting results here.

alex: i'll gate PAUSE25. will approve only if p95<120ms and auth test passes.

emily: note: if we rollback console last, clients may see stale assets for a few mins; have clients been notified? ops-notify sent.

morgan: OK. manual gate at 25% requires alex approval. sasha will watch auth logs and can request router-first rollback if needed.

deploy-bot: PAUSE_AT_25 set with 10m timeout. Streaming stage updates to this thread.

jay: copy. will post T-5 smoke at T-5. Standing by for canary outputs.

morgan: thanks team — ping this thread to trigger immediate rollback. :rocket:
